title: Component: Yazelix terminal support
requirement: Yazelix terminal support must be installed and used, not replaced.

component.name: terminal-support metadata/agent-environment pin
component.role: Versioned support evidence only; it is explicitly not the terminal launcher, renderer, composer, or repair mechanism.

runtime_evidence.result: The native Nix-profile Yazelix executable reported package full, Nushell as its shell, a runtime Zellij configuration, and inside zellij: yes.

replacement.reason: The native yzx Yazelix executable was queried directly. No substitute terminal implementation or metadata repository misuse was introduced.

scope_note: This verifies the required support component's documented role and active native Yazelix runtime. The support repository is not asserted to implement the LifeOS PTY bridge; the blueprint assigns that release-blocking bridge to LifeOS.
